summary: changes_requested. B1, B3 and B4 are functionally confirmed by an independent in-process probe (47/47 PASS). B2 is only partly done. The retry poison from the 4xx status is fixed, but the requirement's clause 'include the contract rejection_code WORD_NOT_FOUND' is not implemented. The shared rule never reads the rejection code, and WORD_NOT_FOUND is used only as the skip label, so a WORD_NOT_FOUND rejection that does not arrive as a 4xx still retries forever. evidence: laravel_audio_worker_state.py:572 is_local = bool(info.get('_local_source')), and :592 'elif not md5 and not is_local'. info['_local_source'] is the stripped task field (:511), so a blank value is not local.

evidence: Done: audio_resource_delivery.py:64-95 adds one shared rule, is_terminal_delivery_rejection(detail, status_code), with RETRYABLE_4XX_HTTP_STATUSES (408, 409, 425, 429). laravel_audio_delivery.py:61-64 _terminal_report_error delegates to it. The import direction (laravel_audio_delivery -> audio_resource_delivery) is unchanged, so there is no cycle. The truth table matches the pre-refactor expression on 16 samples.

Done: at audio_resource_delivery.py:364-379, an md5-less word with a non-throttling 4xx returns {'status': OUTCOME_DONE, 'skipped': 'WORD_NOT_FOUND'}. The probe runs the real _deliver_resource with upload_word_audio and word_audio_media patched. The LDRI-11 400 body, an errorWithCode 404 and a 422 settle DONE, and no md5 is sent. 408/409/425/429/500/502/503, a transport error, 'laravel endpoint not configured' and a 200 success=false stay retryable. A word with md5 and a 400 still raises as before, and the not_found branch is unchanged.

Not done: the clause 'include the contract rejection_code WORD_NOT_FOUND'. The source issue (pycore-ai-D7P2 B2) says 'Once LDRI-11 lands, the contract rejection WORD_NOT_FOUND must also end the row.' The helper takes only detail and status_code and never reads the rejection code, and WORD_NOT_FOUND_REJECTION_CODE (:64) appears only as the skip label (:378). Contract word_identity.fallback_when_md5_absent says a word not in the dictionary 'is rejected with rejection_code', and LDRI-11's verify says it 'returns the reject code'. Neither pins an HTTP status. This controller already answers some outcomes with 200 plus success/data.status (AppQyV1WordMediaController.php:205-214 returns 200 with success true and data.status = $reason). Probe: {'success': False, 'error_code': 'WORD_NOT_FOUND', 'error': 'Word not found'} with no http_status raises RuntimeError('Word not found'), so the row retries every 300 s at most, forever. That is the poison B2 exists to remove.
pycore-ai-D7P2-B2.required_fix: Recognize the rejection code independent of the HTTP status. Add an error_code argument to is_terminal_delivery_rejection that returns True when it equals WORD_NOT_FOUND_REJECTION_CODE. At :366-368, pass receipt.get('error_code') and also treat receipt_status == WORD_NOT_FOUND_REJECTION_CODE (data.status) as terminal. Keep every other branch as it is. The domain-report path passes no code, so its truth table does not change. Re-run the same in-process probe, adding the no-status WORD_NOT_FOUND case and a data.status 'WORD_NOT_FOUND' case.

evidence: word_audio_cache.py:128 adds the _pending map, and :132 adds _load_finished, which is set only in _finish_load (:191) and never reset. note_stored (:244-245) writes live only when the load has finished or the language is installed, and otherwise writes to _pending. _install (:166-175) pops pending entries and merges them newest-wins. _finish_load (:178-191) folds leftover pending languages in. The decision does not depend on _loading (checked in the source).

Probe on a temporary cache root (_get_cache_dir and migrate_legacy_names patched, nothing written to the app data dir). A store before the load leaves lookup_many None, and find_cached_many falls back to the scan and finds all three words (the D7P2 regression scenario). Then the REAL load_all ran on a thread with the 'fr' scan gated. 'en' was already live. A concurrent store into 'fr' during its scan kept 'fr' None, and find_cached fell back to the scan. A language directory created mid-load stayed pending. After the gate was released, 'fr' held the scan result plus the pending store, the mid-load language was folded in at finish, a post-load new language went live at once, and _pending ended empty.

Every writer of the word cache calls note_stored: save_to_cache (:273), store_bytes (:336) and kokoro_batch through save_to_cache. The one load_all caller is the boot chain (event_handlers.py:453), guarded once by _RUNTIME_STEPS_COMPLETED.

issues: B2 (requirement clause and contract, blocking): pycore/pyctl/tts/audio_resource_delivery.py:71-95 and :364-379. The contract rejection_code WORD_NOT_FOUND is not recognized; it is only the skip label. An md5-less word rejected with error_code WORD_NOT_FOUND (or data.status WORD_NOT_FOUND) on a non-4xx response raises RuntimeError and retries forever (probe: no-status WORD_NOT_FOUND gives RuntimeError('Word not found')). Fix: give is_terminal_delivery_rejection an error_code argument (True when it equals WORD_NOT_FOUND_REJECTION_CODE), and at :366-368 pass receipt.get('error_code'), also treating receipt_status == WORD_NOT_FOUND_REJECTION_CODE as terminal. The domain-report caller passes no code, so its behavior is unchanged.

decisions: This verdict supersedes the approved draft written for this task at 20:59 (head 0b6f362e3). That draft recorded 'recognize error_code WORD_NOT_FOUND' as non-blocking on the grounds that errorWithCode maps it to 404. On re-review, the item text ('include the contract rejection_code WORD_NOT_FOUND') and the source issue ('the contract rejection WORD_NOT_FOUND must also end the row') make it a stated requirement. The contract and LDRI-11 do not bind the code to a 4xx, so the claimed 'done' is refuted for that clause. The fix is a few lines.
The comment and alias cleanup (issues[1]) rides in the same round because the member is going back anyway. On its own it would not have blocked.
B1, B3 and the functional part of B4 are accepted as they are. Round 2 must not change them.
